title: Political Tempest: Miranda Devine Slams 'Nonsensical' Anti-Trump 'Bomb LA' Claim
summary: Columnist Miranda Devine has ignited a fresh political debate, labeling a recent claim against former President Donald Trump as the 'far-left's most nonsensical anti-Trump hoax yet.' This controversy centers on accusations that Trump, during a Nebraska rally, allegedly invited Iran to bomb Los Angeles, a narrative Devine asserts is baseless and politically manufactured.
content:
The political arena is once again ablaze with controversy, as conservative columnist Miranda Devine sharply criticizes what she calls the 'far-left’s most nonsensical anti-Trump hoax yet.' Writing for the New York Post, Devine targets a burgeoning narrative suggesting that former President Donald Trump, during a recent rally in Nebraska, explicitly invited Iran to bomb Los Angeles. This provocative claim has quickly become a flashpoint in the ongoing partisan battles, with Devine asserting it’s nothing short of a fabricated attack.

According to Devine, this particular accusation — that a former U.S. President would openly call for a foreign adversary to strike an American city — defies all logic and stretches credulity to its absolute breaking point. She contends that this sensational narrative, despite its inherent absurdity, is being readily amplified by what she terms 'media handmaidens,' who she alleges are swallowing the claim 'hook, line and sinker' without critical scrutiny. For Devine, the willingness of certain outlets to promote such an outlandish story underscores a troubling pattern of partisan reporting.

This latest political skirmish, Devine argues, is not merely a misinterpretation but a deliberate and cynical maneuver designed to influence the upcoming midterm elections. By pushing what she characterizes as a patently false and inflammatory accusation, the intent is purportedly to tarnish Trump’s image and, by extension, damage Republican prospects. However, Devine posits that such an overtly 'nonsensical' strategy will ultimately backfire, alienating moderate voters and bolstering support for the very figures it seeks to undermine, thereby hurting Democratic chances in the critical electoral contests.

In an era frequently defined by intense partisan divides and the rapid dissemination of information, this episode serves as a stark reminder of the challenges in discerning truth from politically motivated spin. As campaigns intensify and rhetoric escalates, the battle over narratives like the 'Bomb LA' claim highlights the precarious balance between factual reporting and the strategic deployment of information in the pursuit of political advantage.
keyTakeaways: Miranda Devine has characterized a claim about former President Trump as a 'nonsensical anti-Trump hoax.'
The 'hoax' alleges that Trump, during a Nebraska rally, invited Iran to bomb Los Angeles.
Devine argues this politically charged narrative, amplified by some media, is intended to damage Trump but will ultimately backfire on Democrats in the midterms.
author: NY Post

title: Dave's Hot Chicken Sizzles Past 500 Locations, Igniting Fast-Casual Expansion
summary: Dave's Hot Chicken celebrated a monumental milestone by opening its 500th restaurant in Phoenix, AZ, on October 8, 2026. This achievement underscores the brand's explosive growth, having added an astonishing 100 new units in just six months since April 2026.
content:
Pasadena's very own Dave's Hot Chicken has officially turned up the heat on the fast-casual industry, announcing the opening of its 500th restaurant in Phoenix, Arizona, on October 8, 2026. This isn't just another opening; it's a blazing testament to rapid expansion, showcasing a brand that has added an incredible 100 new locations to its roster since April of this year alone.

What began as a single pop-up in an East Hollywood parking lot in 2017 has mushroomed into a global phenomenon, captivating palates with its simple yet addictive menu of Nashville-style hot chicken tenders and sliders. The 500-store mark, especially with such accelerated growth, firmly plants Dave's Hot Chicken as a formidable player, challenging established giants and carving out a significant niche in the highly competitive quick-service landscape. This latest Phoenix outpost is more than just a new eatery; it's a beacon of the brand's relentless momentum and consumer appeal.

The strategic, rapid rollout highlights not only robust franchise operations but also an incredibly strong demand for Dave's distinct flavor profile. As the brand continues its fiery ascent, hitting milestones like this reinforces its trajectory from a beloved local secret to an international sensation, promising even more spicy outposts for fans to flock to in the years ahead.
keyTakeaways: Dave's Hot Chicken celebrated the opening of its 500th restaurant in Phoenix, AZ, on October 8, 2026.
The brand has demonstrated exceptional growth, adding 100 new locations in just six months since April 2026.
This milestone solidifies Dave's Hot Chicken's position as a rapidly expanding and dominant force in the global fast-casual dining sector.
author: Staff Writer
